prompts.title: Viral YouTube Hook Generator
prompts.description: Generate 20 scroll-stopping opening hooks for any long-form video topic, ranked by retention probability.
prompts.prompt:
Act as a YouTube retention strategist. For the topic: [TOPIC], generate 20 opening hooks for a long-form video. Each hook must:
1) Start with a curiosity gap
2) Be under 30 seconds when spoken
3) Foreshadow a payoff without spoiling it
Return them ranked from most to least likely to hold 80%+ retention, with a one-line reasoning for each.

prompts.title: Cinematic Color Grade Prompt
prompts.description: Reliable color grading brief for editors — works as a shot list handed to your colorist or graded in DaVinci.
prompts.prompt:
Create a cinematic color grade for [FOOTAGE] with:
- Mood: [MOOD]
- Reference: [REFERENCE FILM]
Deliver a 3-step plan: 1) Primary correction (WB, exposure, contrast), 2) Secondary look (lift/gamma/gain), 3) Signature LUT suggestion. Include scopes targets and node order for DaVinci Resolve.

prompts.title: Midjourney Thumbnail Prompt
prompts.description: Generate an impossible, high-click YouTube thumbnail scene in Midjourney with this angle/lighting rig.
prompts.prompt: Ultra-detailed YouTube thumbnail render, /imagine prompt: [SUBJECT] in [EMOTION] pose, dramatic rim lighting, teal and orange color grade, hyper-detailed face, slight wide angle lens, centered composition with negative space on the left for text, 4k octane render, --ar 16:9 --v 6 --style raw --s 250

prompts.title: YouTube Description SEO Optimizer
prompts.description: Turn a raw draft description into an SEO-optimized, keyword-rich YouTube description with timestamps.
prompts.prompt:
Optimize the following description for YouTube SEO. Include: 1) A keyword-rich first 150 characters, 2) 3 hashtag groups, 3) a 'Watch next' section, 4) timestamps for the outline provided. Keep the tone authentic and avoid keyword stuffing.

Draft: [PASTE DRAFT]

prompts.title: Retention-First Script Rewriter
prompts.description: Rewrite any script so every 15 seconds adds a new visual or verbal element that keeps the viewer watching.
prompts.prompt:
Rewrite this script with retention-first pacing:
1) Cut every sentence that doesn't carry information or emotion forward
2) Insert a visual/video hook marker every 20-30s: [CUT TO], [ZOOM], [B-ROLL], [SFX]
3) End each paragraph with a mini-hook
4) Target spoken length: [LENGTH]

Script: [PASTE SCRIPT]

prompts.title: DALL-E Podcast Cover Art
prompts.description: Prompt a modern, minimal podcast cover with strong contrast — tuned to pop on mobile podcast apps.
prompts.prompt: Minimal podcast cover art, [SHOW NAME], bold geometric shapes, [2-COLOR] palette with strong contrast, high-contrast typography area, no tiny text, centered subject, soft vignette, 3000x3000, flat vector style, DALL-E

prompts.title: TikTok Short Script From Long-Form
prompts.description: Extract 10 high-potential Shorts from one long-form video, each with a clean 3-act structure.
prompts.prompt: From this long-form transcript find the 10 most 'clip-worthy' moments. For each: 1) the exact timestamp range, 2) a rewritten 3-act short script (hook <5s, core <25s, payoff last 5s), 3) a text-overlay hook line, 4) recommended sound/music vibe.

prompts.title: Client Brief Abstraction
prompts.description: Turn a chaotic client brief into a clean project brief with deliverables, tone, deadlines and revision rules.
prompts.prompt:
Convert this client brief into a structured project brief:
- Project summary (2 lines)
- Deliverables checklist
- Creative tone (3 adjectives)
- Must-haves vs. nice-to-haves
- Timeline with proposed milestones
- Revision policy suggestion

Notes: [PASTE NOTES]

prompts.title: Gemini Music & SFX Sync
prompts.description: Plan a music + SFX map for your edit so every beat change lands on the right visual.
prompts.prompt: For a video of [LENGTH] with these sections [LIST]: produce a music & SFX map. For each section: tempo range, genre suggestion, entry/exit cues, SFX recommendations (whoosh, riser, hit, sting), and a note on ducking dialogue levels. Format as a table.

prompts.title: A/B Thumbnail Text Generator
prompts.description: Generate 12 punchy, clickable thumbnail text overlays with zero jargon, sized for mobile views.
prompts.prompt:
Generate 12 thumbnail overlay texts for a video about [TOPIC]. Rules:
1) Max 4 words each
2) Use ONE emotional trigger per text (curiosity/status/fear/loss)
3) No clickbait that is not delivered in the video
4) Specify recommended font weight and placement for each
Return as a ranked list.

prompts.title: Creator Onboarding Flow
prompts.description: A reusable prompt to scope any new client's channel, goals and editing preferences in one structured pass.
prompts.prompt: You are scoping a new video editing client. Ask them to provide: channel URL, 3 recent videos, growth goal (views/subs/both), brand colors, fonts/logo, preferred editing style (clone of [VIDEO]), voiceover preference, turnaround needs, and revision budget. Then output a one-page creative profile I can reuse for every future edit.

prompts.title: Ad Concept Sprint
prompts.description: Generate a full video ad concept — hook, structure, VO script, shot list and CTA — in one prompt.
prompts.prompt: Create a 45-second video ad concept for [PRODUCT]. Deliver: 1) 5 hook options, 2) shot-by-shot storyboard (12-15 shots), 3) VO script with pauses, 4) on-screen text overlays, 5) CTA strategies + 3 variants for the end card.

prompts.title: Faceless Channel Script Blueprint
prompts.description: Structure a full faceless YouTube video — intro, content beats, b-roll prompts and CTA — for any niche.
prompts.prompt: Act as a scriptwriter for faceless YouTube channels. For the niche [NICHE] and title [TITLE], write a full video outline: hook (0-15s), main sections with b-roll shot descriptions, narration script, and an end CTA that drives comments. Keep narration natural and conversational.

prompts.title: Retention Curve Analyzer
prompts.description: Feed in your retention graph and get diagnostic fixes for drop-off points.
prompts.prompt: Given a YouTube audience retention curve with drops at [TIMESTAMPS], diagnose likely causes at each drop and give specific fixes (pacing, visual change, payoff timing, script tightening). Prioritize the top 3 that will move the curve most.

prompts.title: Thumbnail A/B Test Matrix
prompts.description: Design a structured A/B thumbnail test with variations that isolate one variable at a time.
prompts.prompt: For a video about [TOPIC], create an A/B test plan with 4 thumbnail variations. Each variation changes only ONE element (face expression, text, background, color accent). For each, describe the visual, the psychological trigger, and predicted CTR impact.

prompts.title: Retention Fishing Articles/Scripts
prompts.description: Rewrite dense scripts to be bingeable — tighten every paragraph into a hook-forward cut.
prompts.prompt: Rewrite the following script to maximize retention: cut fluff, front-load payoff, add pattern interrupts and cliffhanger transitions every 60 seconds. Return the edited script with notes on what you changed and why.

prompts.title: Short-Form Repurposing Engine
prompts.description: Slice a long video into 10 short-form clips with scroll-stopping opens.
prompts.prompt: From the transcript [PASTE], identify the 10 best 20-45 second clips for Shorts/TikTok. For each: give the timestamp, a rewritten scroll-stopping first line, on-screen caption text, and the hook that prevents skips. Rank by predicted completion.

prompts.title: B-Roll Shot List Generator
prompts.description: Generate a shot-by-shot b-roll list that matches your narration beats.
prompts.prompt: For the following narration script [PASTE], generate a b-roll shot list. Match each narration beat to 1-3 suggested shots with camera movement, focal length, and a stock-search keyword. Group by section.
